blocks.heading: Choose PCB Only If You Like Biology

items.text: If you are undecided and can handle Maths, PCM keeps more doors open, although it closes medicine and some life-science routes.
If you already hold PCB or BiPC, the choice below is real: ten courses, very different ceilings.
Nursing: you must be enrolled in a national or state register to practise.
Allied health (lab, imaging, physiotherapy, optometry, dietetics): the NCAHP Act, 2021 sets up central and state registers.
Clinical psychology: the Mental Healthcare Act asks for a recognised clinical qualification or a postgraduate degree plus a clinical M.Phil.
Government food safety posts: the FSS Rules, 2011 name the degrees.
Biotechnology, microbiology, zoology and botany graduates usually reach an MSc through IIT JAM or CUET PG.
A fellowship or lecturer path adds a third filter: NET, a funded PhD seat, then a scarce permanent post.
Nursing, lab technology and dietetics have a lighter second stage.
